_readme: Copy this to ledger.json and replace every fact with something true about you.
1. One atomic claim per fact. Not a paragraph. Not a story.
2. Only things you can defend in an interview six weeks from now.
3. Put every number, tool name, and proper noun you might want to use in an
answer somewhere in text or tags -- the validator can only trace what is here.
4. Delete anything you are not sure about. An absent fact costs you a sentence.
A wrong fact costs you the interview.

_dropdowns: Everything below answers dropdowns. Surveying 32 real forms, these get asked far
more often than any essay. Leave a field out and the tool REFUSES that question
rather than guessing -- which is what you want, because several of these are legal
workAuthorization must be exactly one of:
authorized_any                     - can work for any employer, no restrictions
authorized_current_employer_only   - tied to your present employer
requires_sponsorship               - need visa sponsorship now or in future
not_authorized                     - not authorized to work in the US

facts.text: I built bamboo, a Node tool that polls the Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby public job board APIs across 67 company boards and refuses to submit any application text that cannot be traced to a verified fact file.

While building bamboo I found that the internship aggregator repo everyone uses lags by up to five days, so I mined it once for company board tokens and polled the vendor APIs directly instead, which cut detection latency to the polling interval.
REPLACE ME: a course you actually took, with the specific thing you built in it.
REPLACE ME: one true sentence about the kind of problem you want to work on and why, that is not flattery aimed at any particular employer.
